name: Escher-like impossible worlds
description: Black-and-white graphic puzzles: tessellations of birds, fish and lizards that morph into each other, impossible staircases and buildings, spheres and reflections.
light: even graphic light, strong black and white contrast, mid greys from hatching
composition: tessellated patterns morphing across the frame, or impossible architecture with several vanishing points
camera_or_medium: woodcut and lithograph, fine engraving lines, limited earthy colour at most
texture_detail: crisp engraved hatching, precise interlocking shapes, paper grain
subjects: birds turning into fish across a grid
a city that folds into a tessellation
